about_the_game:
Introduction:

A while ago, someone broke into your house. The police came, but found no trace. Now, you're a streamer trying to get back to your normal life, but that lingering suspicion never faded. And tonight, the note you found on your car confirmed your deepest fears: 'Always watch your back.'

EYES BEHIND is an atmospheric horror experience where an ordinary evening turns into a desperate struggle for survival, filled with paranoia and sinister coincidences.

Story:

While trying to overcome the recent trauma of a home invasion, you find yourself in the same nightmare after a normal evening with your friend. The unsettling cashier at the gas station, the strange visitor at your door, and the new note you find inside your house... The threat is no longer just outside; it now lurks in the shadows of your own sanctuary. With the power cutting out during your stream, doors left ajar, and a pair of eyes constantly watching you, you must survive the night.

Features:

  • Retro Horror Experience: A nostalgic nightmare that blends the aesthetics and atmosphere of cult horror games with modern gameplay dynamics.

  • Immersive FPS Perspective: Experience the events directly through the character's eyes, feeling every breath and every shadow firsthand.

  • An Intelligent Threat: An unpredictable enemy AI that actively hunts you.

  • Stealth and Strategy: Hide, escape, and use your environment to survive. Every closet, every dark corner can be your shelter.

  • Bilingual Experience: The game offers full support for both Turkish and English interface and subtitles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 | AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti | AMD Radeon R7 265
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F | AMD Ryzen 5 3550H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 | AMD RX 570
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: EYES BEHIND is a retro-style FPS survival horror inspired by the classics. Can you survive a deadly game of hide-and-seek with a sinister stranger? Use your wits and courage to stay alive in this tense psychological thriller.
